stories.title: TurnAggregator frame processor
stories.description: Implement TurnAggregator as Pipecat FrameProcessor that buffers utterances and emits AggregatedTranscriptFrame
acceptanceCriteria: src/turn_aggregator.py exists with TurnAggregator(FrameProcessor) class
TurnAggregator.__init__ accepts: mode, focus_timeout, ambient_timeout, max_turn_duration, max_buffer_size, on_turn_complete
TurnAggregator.add_utterance(text, ts) returns (should_submit, aggregated_text)
Focus mode (0.5s): Single utterance submits immediately after timeout
Ambient mode (3.0s): Multiple utterances with gaps < 3.0s are aggregated
Max turn duration (30s): Forces submit even if still receiving utterances
Max buffer size (50): Forces submit when buffer exceeded
AggregatedTranscriptFrame dataclass defined with: text, utterance_count, turn_start_ts, turn_end_ts
Test file tests/test_turn_aggregator.py exists with >150 lines covering all timeout scenarios
All tests in tests/test_turn_aggregator.py pass
